description: Calculates the number of permutations P(n,k) = n!/(n-k)! representing ordered arrangements of k elements selected from n elements. Returns the count as an integer. (cost: 1 credit)

k.description: integer, required, number of elements to select (must be 0 ≤ k ≤ n)

n.description: integer, required, total number of elements (must be non-negative)

name: permutation_count
